operation_details.item: The user's Channel 1 receives 40% of the media budget.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Let's review the current media plan and clarify how the campaign budget is distributed across channels.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Channel 1 receives 40% of the media budget.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That gives us a clear starting point for discussing the role of each channel in the campaign.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Channel 2 receives 30% of the media budget.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Understood. We can keep the channel roles distinct while reviewing how the overall mix supports the campaign strategy.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Channel 3 receives 20% of the media budget.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Thanks. That completes the stated allocation across the three channels, so we can use it as the working media plan.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The budget allocation is reviewed quarterly.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: A recurring review will help keep the plan aligned with the campaign's brand and customer engagement priorities.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I want the allocation documented clearly in the campaign brief.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: I'll structure the brief so the channel split and review cadence are easy for the campaign team to reference.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: That will make the media plan easier to use during campaign planning.
